name: Smoky Sheet-Pan Chicken Fajitas
desc: Thighs and three peppers with smoked paprika, over cilantro-lime rice

ingredients.raw: 1 red bell pepper, sliced into strips
1 yellow bell pepper, sliced into strips
1 green bell pepper, sliced into strips
1 large yellow onion, sliced into strips

steps: Start the rice: Combine 1 1/2 cups long-grain white rice, dry and 3 cups water with a pinch of salt in a pot. Bring to a boil, cover, reduce to low, and simmer until tender and water is absorbed.

Heat oven and prep: Heat oven to 425°F. Pound 1 1/2 pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs to an even thickness and pat dry. In a small bowl, mix 1 tablespoon chili powder, 2 teaspoons ground cumin, 2 teaspoons smoked paprika, 1 teaspoon garlic powder, 1 teaspoon dried oregano, and 1 teaspoon salt.

Load the sheet pan: Toss 1 red bell pepper, sliced into strips, 1 yellow bell pepper, sliced into strips, 1 green bell pepper, sliced into strips, and 1 large yellow onion, sliced into strips with 2 tablespoons olive oil on a sheet pan, spreading to the edges. Coat the chicken all over in the spice mix and set it in the center of the pan.
Roast: Roast until the chicken hits 160°F internal and the veggies are charred at the edges, 16 to 18 minutes .
Rest and slice: Rest the chicken 5 minutes , then slice into strips.
Finish the rice: Stir the juice of 1 of the 2 limes and 1/3 cup fresh cilantro, chopped into the cooked rice. Cut the remaining lime into wedges for serving.
Plate: Pile chicken and veggies over the cilantro-lime rice and finish with a squeeze of lime.
